heading: ENGINEERED TO CONTROL HEAT
subheading: Turnkey Design, Simulation, Friction Stir Welding & Micro-Channel Cooling Hardware
content: 100% custom-designed and manufactured liquid cold plates, skived arrays, and high-aspect heat sinks. Produced under one roof in Guelph, Ontario with zero shelf inventory.

heading: Friction Stir Welding in Guelph, ON
subheading: Void-free solid-state joints engineered for extreme coolant pressures and high-vibration applications.
content: In-house friction stir welding enables hermetic sealing without melting the base alloy, delivering unmatched mechanical integrity and zero porosity for electric vehicles, aerospace, and high-power electronics.

heading: Your Single-Source Thermal Management Partner
subheading: Bringing advanced engineering and precision manufacturing together under one roof.
content: Innovative Thermal Solutions (ITS) designs and manufactures custom, high-performance thermal management solutions in North America, specializing in Friction Stir Welding (FSW) and advanced cooling technologies.
